--TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.CRM_CIFGROUPS

DECLARE @DATETOPROCESS DATE
SET @DATETOPROCESS = '2024-05-31'

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CIFGROUPS_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CIFGROUPS_SELECT_SRC
(
                GRPID,
                BANK_ID,
                GROUPID,
                GROUPTYPE,
                RATING,
                GROUPNAME_NATIVE,
                PARENTGROUP,
                INDUSTRY,
                PRIMARY_SOL_ID,
                RISKRATING,
                RISKRATINGMODEL,
                RISKRATINGDONEON,
                OVRDN_RISKRATING,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNON,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNBY,
                ANNUALREVIEWDATE,
                INTERIMREVIEWDATE,
                REVIEWINGTEAM,
                STRICTREPORTINGMARKER,
                ONWATCHLIST,
                RELATIONSHIP_STDATE,
                GROUPNAME,
                RELATIONSHIPMGRID,
                ISSUSPENDED,
                NOTES,
                RELATIONSHIPMGR,
                BOCREATEDBY,
                BODATECREATED,
                BOMODIFIEDBY,
                BODATEMODIFIED,
                CONCURDETECT_X,
                TMDATE,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                GRPID,
                BANK_ID,
                GROUPID,
                GROUPTYPE,
                RATING,
                GROUPNAME_NATIVE,
                PARENTGROUP,
                INDUSTRY,
                PRIMARY_SOL_ID,
                RISKRATING,
                RISKRATINGMODEL,
                RISKRATINGDONEON,
                OVRDN_RISKRATING,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNON,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNBY,
                ANNUALREVIEWDATE,
                INTERIMREVIEWDATE,
                REVIEWINGTEAM,
                STRICTREPORTINGMARKER,
                ONWATCHLIST,
                RELATIONSHIP_STDATE,
                GROUPNAME,
                RELATIONSHIPMGRID,
                ISSUSPENDED,
                NOTES,
                RELATIONSHIPMGR,
                BOCREATEDBY,
                BODATECREATED,
                BOMODIFIEDBY,
                BODATEMODIFIED,
                CONCURDETECT_X,
                TMDATE,
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_CIFGROUPS]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CIFGROUPS_SELECT_SRC
(
                GRPID,
                BANK_ID,
                GROUPID,
                GROUPTYPE,
                RATING,
                GROUPNAME_NATIVE,
                PARENTGROUP,
                INDUSTRY,
                PRIMARY_SOL_ID,
                RISKRATING,
                RISKRATINGMODEL,
                RISKRATINGDONEON,
                OVRDN_RISKRATING,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNON,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNBY,
                ANNUALREVIEWDATE,
                INTERIMREVIEWDATE,
                REVIEWINGTEAM,
                STRICTREPORTINGMARKER,
                ONWATCHLIST,
                RELATIONSHIP_STDATE,
                GROUPNAME,
                RELATIONSHIPMGRID,
                ISSUSPENDED,
                NOTES,
                RELATIONSHIPMGR,
                BOCREATEDBY,
                BODATECREATED,
                BOMODIFIEDBY,
                BODATEMODIFIED,
                CONCURDETECT_X,
                TMDATE,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.GRPID,
                CC.BANK_ID,
                CC.GROUPID,
                CC.GROUPTYPE,
                CC.RATING,
                CC.GROUPNAME_NATIVE,
                CC.PARENTGROUP,
                CC.INDUSTRY,
                CC.PRIMARY_SOL_ID,
                CC.RISKRATING,
                CC.RISKRATINGMODEL,
                CC.RISKRATINGDONEON,
                CC.OVRDN_RISKRATING,
                CC.RISKRATING_OVRDNON,
                CC.RISKRATING_OVRDNBY,
                CC.ANNUALREVIEWDATE,
                CC.INTERIMREVIEWDATE,
                CC.REVIEWINGTEAM,
                CC.STRICTREPORTINGMARKER,
                CC.ONWATCHLIST,
                CC.RELATIONSHIP_STDATE,
                CC.GROUPNAME,
                CC.RELATIONSHIPMGRID,
                CC.ISSUSPENDED,
                CC.NOTES,
                CC.RELATIONSHIPMGR,
                CC.BOCREATEDBY,
                CC.BODATECREATED,
                CC.BOMODIFIEDBY,
                CC.BODATEMODIFIED,
                CC.CONCURDETECT_X,
                CC.TMDATE,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.CRM_CIFGROUPS CC
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CIFGROUPS_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CIFGROUPS_GROUP_SRC
(
                GRPID,
                BANK_ID,
                GROUPID,
                GROUPTYPE,
                RATING,
                GROUPNAME_NATIVE,
                PARENTGROUP,
                INDUSTRY,
                PRIMARY_SOL_ID,
                RISKRATING,
                RISKRATINGMODEL,
                RISKRATINGDONEON,
                OVRDN_RISKRATING,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNON,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNBY,
                ANNUALREVIEWDATE,
                INTERIMREVIEWDATE,
                REVIEWINGTEAM,
                STRICTREPORTINGMARKER,
                ONWATCHLIST,
                RELATIONSHIP_STDATE,
                GROUPNAME,
                RELATIONSHIPMGRID,
                ISSUSPENDED,
                NOTES,
                RELATIONSHIPMGR,
                BOCREATEDBY,
                BODATECREATED,
                BOMODIFIEDBY,
                BODATEMODIFIED,
                CONCURDETECT_X,
                TMDATE,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                GRPID,
                BANK_ID,
                GROUPID,
                GROUPTYPE,
                RATING,
                GROUPNAME_NATIVE,
                PARENTGROUP,
                INDUSTRY,
                PRIMARY_SOL_ID,
                RISKRATING,
                RISKRATINGMODEL,
                RISKRATINGDONEON,
                OVRDN_RISKRATING,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNON,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNBY,
                ANNUALREVIEWDATE,
                INTERIMREVIEWDATE,
                REVIEWINGTEAM,
                STRICTREPORTINGMARKER,
                ONWATCHLIST,
                RELATIONSHIP_STDATE,
                GROUPNAME,
                RELATIONSHIPMGRID,
                ISSUSPENDED,
                NOTES,
                RELATIONSHIPMGR,
                BOCREATEDBY,
                BODATECREATED,
                BOMODIFIEDBY,
                BODATEMODIFIED,
                CONCURDETECT_X,
                TMDATE,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                GRPID,
                BANK_ID,
                GROUPID,
                GROUPTYPE,
                RATING,
                GROUPNAME_NATIVE,
                PARENTGROUP,
                INDUSTRY,
                PRIMARY_SOL_ID,
                RISKRATING,
                RISKRATINGMODEL,
                RISKRATINGDONEON,
                OVRDN_RISKRATING,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNON,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNBY,
                ANNUALREVIEWDATE,
                INTERIMREVIEWDATE,
                REVIEWINGTEAM,
                STRICTREPORTINGMARKER,
                ONWATCHLIST,
                RELATIONSHIP_STDATE,
                GROUPNAME,
                RELATIONSHIPMGRID,
                ISSUSPENDED,
                NOTES,
                RELATIONSHIPMGR,
                BOCREATEDBY,
                BODATECREATED,
                BOMODIFIEDBY,
                BODATEMODIFIED,
                CONCURDETECT_X,
                TMDATE,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CIFGROUPS_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                GRPID,
                BANK_ID,
                GROUPID,
                GROUPTYPE,
                RATING,
                GROUPNAME_NATIVE,
                PARENTGROUP,
                INDUSTRY,
                PRIMARY_SOL_ID,
                RISKRATING,
                RISKRATINGMODEL,
                RISKRATINGDONEON,
                OVRDN_RISKRATING,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNON,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNBY,
                ANNUALREVIEWDATE,
                INTERIMREVIEWDATE,
                REVIEWINGTEAM,
                STRICTREPORTINGMARKER,
                ONWATCHLIST,
                RELATIONSHIP_STDATE,
                GROUPNAME,
                RELATIONSHIPMGRID,
                ISSUSPENDED,
                NOTES,
                RELATIONSHIPMGR,
                BOCREATEDBY,
                BODATECREATED,
                BOMODIFIEDBY,
                BODATEMODIFIED,
                CONCURDETECT_X,
                TMDATE
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @DATETOPROCESS;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.CRM_CIFGROUPS A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CIFGROUPS_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.GRPID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.GRPID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.CRM_CIFGROUPS
(
                GRPID,
                BANK_ID,
                GROUPID,
                GROUPTYPE,
                RATING,
                GROUPNAME_NATIVE,
                PARENTGROUP,
                INDUSTRY,
                PRIMARY_SOL_ID,
                RISKRATING,
                RISKRATINGMODEL,
                RISKRATINGDONEON,
                OVRDN_RISKRATING,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNON,
                RISKRATING_OVRDNBY,
                ANNUALREVIEWDATE,
                INTERIMREVIEWDATE,
                REVIEWINGTEAM,
                STRICTREPORTINGMARKER,
                ONWATCHLIST,
                RELATIONSHIP_STDATE,
                GROUPNAME,
                RELATIONSHIPMGRID,
                ISSUSPENDED,
                NOTES,
                RELATIONSHIPMGR,
                BOCREATEDBY,
                BODATECREATED,
                BOMODIFIEDBY,
                BODATEMODIFIED,
                CONCURDETECT_X,
                TMDATE,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                SRC.GRPID,
                SRC.BANK_ID,
                SRC.GROUPID,
                SRC.GROUPTYPE,
                SRC.RATING,
                SRC.GROUPNAME_NATIVE,
                SRC.PARENTGROUP,
                SRC.INDUSTRY,
                SRC.PRIMARY_SOL_ID,
                SRC.RISKRATING,
                SRC.RISKRATINGMODEL,
                SRC.RISKRATINGDONEON,
                SRC.OVRDN_RISKRATING,
                SRC.RISKRATING_OVRDNON,
                SRC.RISKRATING_OVRDNBY,
                SRC.ANNUALREVIEWDATE,
                SRC.INTERIMREVIEWDATE,
                SRC.REVIEWINGTEAM,
                SRC.STRICTREPORTINGMARKER,
                SRC.ONWATCHLIST,
                SRC.RELATIONSHIP_STDATE,
                SRC.GROUPNAME,
                SRC.RELATIONSHIPMGRID,
                SRC.ISSUSPENDED,
                SRC.NOTES,
                SRC.RELATIONSHIPMGR,
                SRC.BOCREATEDBY,
                SRC.BODATECREATED,
                SRC.BOMODIFIEDBY,
                SRC.BODATEMODIFIED,
                SRC.CONCURDETECT_X,
                SRC.TMDATE,
				@DATETOPROCESS,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5),
				'CRM',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CIFGROUPS_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
